prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent character sprite for a Japanese preschool cooking app.
Edit target: the attached approved screenshot 03_onigiri.png, specifically the boy at the left-center holding rice in both hands. Extract THIS EXACT ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER only, including entire white chef hat, dark black-brown fringe, face, ears, hair, neck, white shirt, arms, hands, the white rice ball held between both hands, and yellow apron with green leaf mark.
Do not redesign him. Preserve the original illustration's face outline, small curved black eyes with same tiny highlights, eyebrow shape, nose, wide open smiling mouth with the same narrow white upper tooth line, skin color, black fringe silhouette and shine, head tilt, clothes, proportions, and holding-rice pose. Preserve the flat softly shaded storybook style of this specific approved screenshot, do not substitute any other version of the boy.
Only remove the kitchen background, table, bowl of rice, plates, arrows, speech bubbles, decorative motion marks, text, cards, and all interface elements. The rice in his hands must remain. Complete the bust lower edge neatly where originally occluded by the table, with no legs. Full hat and both elbows must be contained.
Composition: portrait or near-square cutout centered with modest transparent padding, character fills most canvas. Match approximately a 500 by 560 design-pixel display slot, output at least 1000 pixels tall.
Background: true transparent alpha, no white rectangular backdrop, no checkerboard pattern, no drop shadow, no text or extra objects.
inspection: Compared approved screen03 and generated bust. Same head tilt, fringe, small curved eyes, open smile, shirt, yellow leaf apron, both hands holding rice. Background/UI removed. Raster copy only, no editing or recoloring.

additionalAssets.name: rice-tub
additionalAssets.prompt: 原本03の左下にある木のおひつを、ゲーム用の独立したイラスト素材として抽出してください。おひつ、ご飯、木のしゃもじだけを切り抜きます。画面の左端で隠れている木の輪郭だけを補完し、それ以外の色・形・木目・お米の粒は原本の絵のままです。背景は完全透明のPNG。茶色の光、ぼかし、発光、影、接地影、グラデーションの背景は絶対に入れないでください。木のおひつの物理的な輪郭のすぐ外側は alpha=0 の透明にしてください。切り抜きシールのように明瞭な外周。おひつの内部としゃもじとご飯は不透明。黒い背景や白い背景、人物、台、UI、文字、吹き出し、枠はありません。1個だけを中央に、約3:2の横長の素材。

additionalAssets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this exact nori onigiri cutout. Change ONLY the dark seaweed rectangle: remove the seaweed and fill that rectangular area seamlessly with the same white cooked rice and small cream-colored rice grain texture that surrounds it.
PRESERVE the outer silhouette EXACTLY: this must remain an unmistakable triangle with ONE apex at the top center, TWO sloping sides descending diagonally to rounded bottom corners, and a FLAT horizontal bottom.
